name: claude
description: Run built-in or user-defined Claude agents inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: Run Claude decision counsel, combined code or document reviews, and user-defined read-only agents through native Codex subagents. Configure Claude authentication, model and effort, and inspect exact saved replies.
defaultPrompt: Use $claude:decide to challenge a proposal or $claude:review to review changes.
Use $claude:agent to run a custom Claude agent.
